body:
## Why
Jakub, 2026-11-19: "potřebuji aby si četli celé ty maily aji celé ty přílohy". Agents (Sára, Agentury, Účetní) must read whole mails and every attachment. Today:

1. `mail_get_attachment` returns the file only as base64 text. A 242 kB PDF (sara@, uid 536, 19. 11.) came back as 323 484 characters, too big for the agent's tool output, so the agent had to decode it with its own shell. An agent cannot read a PDF, a Word file or an image from base64 text.
2. `mail_list` / `mail_search` report `has_attachments: false` and `size_bytes` ≈ 1.5 kB for mails that do carry attachments, because `list_messages` / `search_raw` fetch with `headers_only=True` (src/mail_mcp/imap.py). Agents then skip attachments. `mail_get` lists them correctly.

## What to build
- `mail_get_attachment` gains a readable mode and makes it the default:
  - **PDF** → extracted text per page (pure-Python library with a compatible licence, e.g. pypdf). If a page has no text layer (scan), say so for that page and also return the page as an image so a vision model can read it.
  - **Images** (png, jpg, gif, webp, heic if feasible) → MCP image content (`ImageContent`, base64 + mime type) so the model sees the picture, downscaled to stay under a sane size.
  - **DOCX, XLSX, ODT, ODS, PPTX** → text (tables as rows); **TXT, CSV, HTML, EML, XML, JSON, ISDOC** → text (HTML stripped to text).
  - Text output capped by a new setting (e.g. `MAX_ATTACHMENT_TEXT_CHARS`, default 200 000) with an explicit `truncated: true` and the total length, never silently cut.
  - The raw bytes stay available with `format: "base64"` for agents that need the original file (e.g. uploading it elsewhere).
  - Keep the `UNTRUSTED_CONTENT_NOTE` around extracted text exactly like the body.
- `mail_list` / `mail_search` / thread summaries report the real `has_attachments` and `size_bytes`: fetch `BODYSTRUCTURE` and `RFC822.SIZE` (still no body download, still no mark-seen), and list attachment file names in the summary.
- `mail_get`: keep `body_truncated`; add the total body length when truncated.

## Done when
- Tests: a fixture mail with a text PDF, a scanned PDF, a PNG, a DOCX and an XLSX; each returns readable content; base64 mode still returns the original bytes; list/search report `has_attachments: true` and the real size for it; listing never marks mail seen.
- README documents the formats, limits and the new setting.
- No new network calls, no external services; extraction runs inside the container.

## Rollout (needs Jakub)
mcp-mail is a "Jakub approves" repo: open a PR with tests, qa-ok and security-ok, Jakub merges. The three instances on srv (sara, andy, ucetni) are redeployed after the merge.
title: Agents must read whole mails and every attachment: readable attachments + real has_attachments in lists
